name: Peachblossom Elfland
description: Peach blossom fairyland theme, beautiful and romantic, protecting beautiful fate. The peach blossoms and pavilions are scattered and scattered, creating a beautiful scenery, interpreting the beauty of oriental architectural art; the peach blossoms are in full bloom, embellishing the pearls, corridors and pavilions with a clear and elegant look, and awe-inspiring fairy spirit; the pink gold color scheme is delicate but not gaudy, pretty but not vulgar, which further shows the smart and elegant temperament of the peach blossom palace.
